verdict.rationale: The docs show you can restrict results to a domain with the `site:` operator (e.g. `site:github.com rust tutorials`). Goggles let you boost or demote specific websites and domains and are billed as "custom reranking & result filtering", which covers the core of including and excluding domains. Missing for 10: an explicit documented way to exclude a domain outright (Goggles is described as demoting, and `-site:` is not shown), detail on the Goggles syntax and setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
